decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 2 - The occupants of the dwelling shall be limited only to persons referred to the owners by the London Borough of Hounslow, and shall be limited to no more than 6 persons at one time

Condition : 3 - The existing concrete surface on the forecourt shall be broken out, the forecourt laid to grass as shown on the approved plans and the proposed1one-metre high front wall shall be built across the full width of the forecourt, other than at the point of pedestrian access on the west side, within three months of the date of this approval and permanently retained thereafter.

Condition : 4 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions, the continued use of the premises for temporary residential accommodation for up to six unrelated homeless persons satisfies an established demand for accommodation within the Borough without harm to the living conditions of surrounding residents or highway safety and is therefore acceptable in accordance with adopted Unitary Development Plan Policies ENV- B.1.1 (All New Development), H.3.4A (Houses in Multiple Occupation) and ENV-P.1.3 (Surface Water Run Off)
description: Continued use as house in multiple occupancy
